main.summary: Metadata carried in a segmented upload envelope request.

property.name: Length
property.summary: Requested write payload length in bytes.

property.name: ExpectedStateVersion
property.summary: Optional expected current transfer state version that, when supplied, must match before the segment is accepted.

property.name: SegmentSHA512
property.summary: SHA-512 of the payload carried by the envelope.

main.summary: Metadata carried in a segmented upload envelope response.

property.name: Range
property.summary: Logical range associated with this upload result.

property.name: CompletedCoverage
property.summary: Whether full logical coverage exists after acceptance.

property.name: Replayed
property.summary: Whether the request matched an already-committed range.

property.name: Updated
property.summary: Authoritative manifest update time for an accepted segment, when available.

field.name: StrictParsingOptions
field.summary: Serializer options that reject duplicate and unmapped properties and require the response and range fields used for parsing.

method.name: TryParseWithRequiredFields
method.summary: Parses a segmented upload response, requiring all response fields and both Range.Offset and Range.Length. This checks JSON structure, not business validity.
method.param: The parsed response on success; otherwise null.
method.returns: True when the content can be parsed with the required fields; otherwise false.

method.name: RequireResponseProperties
method.summary: Marks response properties and the nested range offset and length as required for the strict parsing contract.
